title: v2 ingest rewrites an authored full stop into ' -- ', its own field delimiter, so a row gains a boundary its author never wrote
body:
**Reported upstream by conflab-vc on hv's explicit instruction; full evidence in Conflab issue `0011` (HIGH). The fourth of four ingest-damage classes. THE OTHER THREE, BY NUMBERS READ FROM THE TOOL RATHER THAN PREDICTED: `0124` prose discarded between fields, `0126` splice, `0127` note field absent.**

**THE ONLY ONE OF THE FOUR THAT IS LATENT RATHER THAN LOST.** Nothing has gone missing today.

**MEASURED ON CONFLAB:** ST0121/AT-03.16 GAINED two characters. What changed is that an authored full stop was rewritten into ` -- ` -- **the ingest's own field delimiter** -- immediately before *"**All three endpoints verified against the live providers.**"*. **Four rows carry it: ST0121/AT-02.2, ST0121/AT-03.22, ST0121/AT-03.16, ST0123/AT-01.3.**

**WHY IT MATTERS DESPITE LOSING NOTHING.** The row now carries a delimiter the author never wrote, at exactly the kind of position `0124` discards between. A future re-ingest, or any consumer that field-extracts on ` -- `, will read that injected boundary as a field separator. **The damage is not in the artefact; it is in what the artefact will do the next time it is read.**

**THE CONSEQUENCE IS NOT MEASURED, AND conflab-vc DECLINED TO ASSUME IT IN EITHER DIRECTION -- which is the right call and is why this is filed as its own class rather than folded into `0124`.** What it wants is a positive control: **re-render one affected row and see whether the clause after the injected delimiter survives.** Until someone drives that, "it will be discarded next time" is a prediction, not a finding.

**A CORRECTION CARRIED FROM THE REPORTER, because it is the more useful half of this entry.** conflab-vc's first scan for this class reported **157 rows** gaining a ` -- `. **That number counts the generator legitimately appending its own ` -- covers ...` and ` -- satisfied: ...` fields -- IT MEASURES THE TOOL WORKING CORRECTLY.** Narrowing the signature to authored punctuation REPLACED by the delimiter gives the real **4**. They caught it before sending. **A census whose denominator is the pattern under test is this estate's most-repeated instrument defect, and 157 would have been a forty-fold overstatement of a real class** -- which is worse than a wrong number, because the class is real and the inflated count would have survived scrutiny of the class.
